# Deboli -> Stanislaw August, St Petersburg, 6 May 1791, Nr 15; AGAD Zbior Popielow 5, despatch 037, img 0178-0179.
# Decipherment: ZbPop 421 img 0060-0061 (transcription/zbpop421_037_clear.txt).
# Conventions as zbpop5_001-003.txt: groups space-separated; a/b/c/e/z = small letter written below/after last digit;
# _u underlined; ^ mark above; ? uncertain digit; {clear text/notes}. Read 27 Oct 2026 from full-resolution crops (1.75x).
# NB this despatch is NOT in the code of 001-003/032: its frequent groups (1053, 1151, 281, 114, 335, 1172, 1200, 1569)
# are those of the 1792 Danzig letters (ZbPop 415, transcription/zbpop415_1792_mixed.txt), and 1786/1657/1559 are absent.
